sources.title: Labor Law No. 43/NA of 24 December 2013 (Amended), unofficial English translation updated 13 October 2014, art. 101 (published by the ASEAN Secretariat)
sources.said: Employers may accept employees under the age of eighteen years but not younger than fourteen years; however, they are prohibited from working overtime. When necessary, the employer may accept and use youth employees under the age of fourteen, but not younger than twelve years, and must ensure the work is light work
